title: Croatian-Style Stew with Kickin' Kick
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with kickin' kick, croatian sausage, and tender tofu, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add cubed tofu and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add sliced carrots and potatoes, cook for 5 minutes.
Add Croatian sausage and cook until browned, breaking up with a spoon as needed.
Add tomato paste, diced tomatoes, and kickin' kick. Stir to combine.
Bring stew to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Season stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
